This indoor walking workout is suitable for beginners and anyone who wants to add more movement to their day. No equipment needed—just press play and walk along from the comfort of your home. Total step count today is 2032 steps.
This 20-minute workout can help you:
Increase your daily step count
Improve cardiovascular fitness
Burn calories
Build endurance
Boost your mood and energy
Whether you're exercising in the morning, during your lunch break, or in the evening, this low impact walking workout is an easy way to fit movement into your day.
